title: Kestnbaum Professor of Labor and Industry
bio: Benjamin Sachs is the Kestnbaum Professor of Labor and Industry at Harvard Law School and a leading expert in the field of labor law and labor relations. He is also faculty director of the Center for Labor and a Just Economy. Professor Sachs teaches courses in labor law and employment law, and his writing focuses on union organizing […]
